name: create-link
title: Create Link
description: Copy browser-tab links in various formats or turn a clipboard URL into a rich title hyperlink for Slack.
author: sinsky

commands.name: copy-clipboard-for-slack
commands.title: Copy Clipboard URL for Slack
commands.subtitle: Create Link
commands.description: Fetch the title of a clipboard URL and copy a rich hyperlink for Slack, with the original URL as plain text.

commands.name: copy-plain-text
commands.title: Copy Link as Plain Text
commands.subtitle: Create Link
commands.description: Copy the URL of the frontmost tab as plain text.

commands.name: copy-html
commands.title: Copy Link as HTML
commands.subtitle: Create Link
commands.description: Copy the URL of the frontmost tab as an HTML link.

commands.name: copy-markdown
commands.title: Copy Link as Markdown
commands.subtitle: Create Link
commands.description: Copy the URL of the frontmost tab as a Markdown link.

commands.name: copy-custom
commands.title: Copy Link as Custom
commands.subtitle: Create Link
commands.description: Copy the URL of the frontmost tab using a custom format.

preferences.name: customFormat
preferences.title: Custom Link Format
preferences.description: Enter the desired format for the custom link. Available placeholders: {url} for the URL, {title} for the page title, {id} for the tab ID, and {favicon} for the favicon URL.

commands.name: show-tabs
commands.title: Show Tabs
commands.subtitle: Create Link
commands.description: Show all open tabs and copy the URL of the selected one.

preferences.name: defaultCopyFormat
preferences.title: Default Copy Format
preferences.description: Select the default action to perform when a tab is selected.

preferences.name: customFormat
preferences.title: Custom Link Format
preferences.description: Enter the desired format for the custom link. Available placeholders: {url} for the URL, {title} for the page title, {id} for the tab ID, and {favicon} for the favicon URL.

echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
